chunks: From him, from some of our companions, from Isma'il ibn Jabir.
Indeed, Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام would give the adhan while another person would perform the iqamah, and he would perform the iqamah when another person had already given the adhan.

key_terms.يُؤَذِّنُ: gives the adhan, the call to salat (prayer)
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: gives the iqamah, the commencement call for salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Can one person give the adhan while another person gives the iqamah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Imam Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام regarding the adhan and iqamah. It indicates that the one who gives the adhan does not necessarily have to be the same person who gives the iqamah, reflecting flexibility in the performance of these acts of worship.
